DRIPLINE

Stratos 95 SP - Diffused Taupe Layers Edition

1

Blending tonal elegance with athletic heritage, the Stratos 95 in Diffused Taupe delivers a layered design built for comfort and edge. Its sculpted midsole, cushioned air pods, and textured overlays make it a statement piece for both streetwear and lifestyle looks.

 

Material & Care

  • Upper: Suede, mesh & synthetic overlays | Sole: Rubber with cushioned air pods

  • Wipe clean with a soft damp cloth, air dry only
